is_read, attribution).

AgentRetailerOut.title: AgentRetailerOut

DeliveryProof.title: DeliveryProof

LandingAdminOut.description: Admin list/detail — the raw content blob (groups hold product ids).
LandingAdminOut.title: LandingAdminOut

Public payload for /landings/{slug} — meta + per-section content + the
product groups with their products resolved from the catalog.

LandingGroupOut.description: One product carousel on a landing — a named group of resolved products.
LandingGroupOut.title: LandingGroupOut

OrderTrackOut.description:
Public order-status view (reference + phone lookup). Deliberately omits
stored PII (name/address) — the customer already has it; the response only
confirms status + line items + the status timeline.
OrderTrackOut.title: OrderTrackOut

PortfolioAdminOut.description: Admin list/detail — the raw content blob (groups hold product ids).
PortfolioAdminOut.title: PortfolioAdminOut

PortfolioPublicOut.description:
Public payload for /portfolios — one curated section with its products
resolved from the catalog. Reuses the landing group shape.
PortfolioPublicOut.title: PortfolioPublicOut

SerialEventOut.description:
One passport-timeline entry. `minted` is derived from created_at; stored
types are sold/revoked/restored (+ warranty/buyback in later phases).
SerialEventOut.title: SerialEventOut

SerialOut.description:
Admin view. `code` is the display form; verify_count/first_verified_at come
from the scan log (the copy-attack signal).
SerialOut.title: SerialOut

SerialVerifyOut.description:
Public authenticity certificate — reads the SNAPSHOT (no live join, no PII,
no internal status). `issued_at` is the code's generation date, not a sale date.
`events` is the passport timeline (issue + sale).
SerialVerifyOut.title: SerialVerifyOut

get.description:
Public authenticity check. The hand-typed code is normalized, then looked up.
Unknown AND revoked codes return the SAME opaque 404 (a revoked code is not
authentic). Every hit is logged as the copy-attack signal. Never cached, and
rate-limited so valid codes can't be enumerated/scraped.
